name: CHAOS SIGIL
text: The Reward Earned ploy costs you 0 CP.

name: SINISTER TROPHIES
text: When an enemy operative shoots, fights or retaliates against a friendly token holder within 2 inches of it, that enemy cannot re-roll attack dice showing 1.

name: SYMBOLS OF BLOODY WORSHIP
text: When a friendly Blooded operative ends an action without being incapacitated, having dealt damage to an enemy during it, it regains 1 lost wound.

name: WICKED BLADES
text: The bayonet, Chieftain's bayonet, bayonet & shield and improvised blade of friendly Blooded operatives have +1 to both Dmg values for the battle.
